name: United Methodist Church

citations.excerpt: In 1968, a long process of consolidation of various Methodist churches in the United States culminated in the formation of the United Methodist Church by the merger of the Methodist Church (1939-1968) and the United Evangelical Brethren.
which united with the Methodist Church to form the United Methodist Church in 1968.

facts.value: Formed in 1968 when the Evangelical United Brethren Church united with the Methodist Church, itself formed in 1939 by the union of three Methodist bodies. It has member churches in Africa, Asia and Europe.
